implementation_signoff.statement: Transfer-v2 implementation is identity-bound to GitHub user Apeloff1 at the cited reconciled payload SHA. The payload adds six quarantined legacy GameForge AI trees and twenty backend-core compatibility-convergence mappings using exact source Git objects, and refreshes five non-exception automation mirrors that drifted after PR #1930 merged. This attestation records staged-mirror preparation only; canonical-owner convergence, import inversion, source retirement, full 130-mapping parity validation, green CI, AIQ/work-package completion, and independent verification remain separately gated.

verification_signoff.statement: Pending distinct verification after the final transfer-v2 validation PR is green. BASE-FRONTEND-TSC-01 is resolved; BASE-FRONTEND-SSR-RAF-01 has a repair applied and awaits App Assembly proof.

parity_policy.python: AST-equivalent to the compatibility source unless the mapping declares a compatibility_facade exception
parity_policy.non_python: byte-identical to the compatibility source unless the mapping declares an explicit exception
parity_policy.rationale: Formatting-only Python normalization must not create false migration drift, while semantic code changes and non-Python content drift still fail closed.

planned_path_audit.policy: Every concrete masterplan skeleton/* implementation root must be migrated, intentionally external with an architecture owner, covered by a migrated alias, or absent. A planned-but-absent engine root appearing later fails validation until classified.

intentionally_external.reason: application manifest and product runtime assembly remain outside engine implementation ownership
artifact/product assets are not executable AI engine ownership
shared startup/configuration authority intentionally remains a top-level architecture plane
release/deployment ownership validates the AI engine but must not be nested inside it
test evidence remains repository-level and must exercise both legacy compatibility paths and canonical AI destinations
shell/UI adapters remain product-facing compatibility surfaces rather than canonical AI engine ownership

provenance_refresh.note: Source object identities refreshed after parity-preserving whitespace normalization; baseline_git_sha remains the original migration baseline.

whitespace_normalization.policy: Whitespace-only normalization was applied atomically to both legacy sources and exact AI mirrors; recorded source tree identities were refreshed without changing runtime semantics.

provider_boundary_note: Credential-marker-bearing destination files are compatibility facades only; exact parity remains mandatory for all undeclared files.

validation_blockers.evidence: At detection time, the migration payload changed no frontend/* files. TypeScript failure is therefore inherited from the base/merged frontend state rather than introduced by the AI-tree migration.
representative_errors: StatusBar backgroundColor/translucent props rejected by current types
StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject missing from current React Native types

validation_blockers.effect: Historical blocker retained for provenance. TypeScript validation is green; the active inherited frontend gate is BASE-FRONTEND-SSR-RAF-01.

resolution_evidence.note: PR #1936 resolved the TypeScript declaration/toolchain blocker. The same run later failed in Expo static export for a different reason.

validation_blockers.failure_origin: react-native-worklets/lib/module/threads.js under Node v24.20.0 during Expo static rendering
validation_blockers.evidence: PR #1936 merged the Expo 54 React/React Native alignment and closed BASE-FRONTEND-TSC-01. Its latest available App Assembly progressed through TypeScript and reducer validation, then failed during Node-side static web export. Transfer-v2 contains no frontend/* changes, so this is inherited base-state debt rather than a transfer-v2 regression.
validation_blockers.effect: Cutover remains blocked until App Assembly proves the guarded SSR repair closes the static export failure.
validation_blockers.repair_summary: Added an Expo Router custom entry point that installs requestAnimationFrame/cancelAnimationFrame only when absent before loading expo-router/entry; package main now points to index.js.

repair.strategy: version- and shape-guarded node_modules compatibility patch
repair.behavior: preserve browser/native requestAnimationFrame; use setTimeout(callback, 0) only when requestAnimationFrame is unavailable during Node static rendering
repair.fail_closed: patch script rejects unexpected package versions, missing targets, or changed vulnerable source shape

priority_one_migration.policy: Exact source-object mirrors are now governed mappings. Legacy imports remain authoritative compatibility paths until focused cutover tests and independent verification are complete.

priority_two_overlay_migration.policy: Parent exact mirrors ignore only explicitly declared overlay children, and every overlay child must be a separately governed mapping.

priority_three_migration.policy: Historical/research mappings preserve lineage and do not gain production authority from relocation.

object_audit.note: Transfer-v2 remains structurally and semantically parity-clean across 130 mappings. post_1930_parity_repair.policy: Only non-exception exact-parity files are mirrored. Credential-sensitive parity exceptions remain non-owning facades.

full_130_mapping_audit.method: Git tree/blob identity + governed overlay membership + compatibility-facade contract inspection; Python mirror parity additionally permits AST-equivalent whitespace-only normalization per scripts/check_ai_file_tree.py

quarantine_hygiene_normalization.policy: Trailing whitespace was stripped only from staged research-quarantine Python destinations. Legacy sources remain unchanged. The canonical validator permits Python AST-equivalent parity, so semantic migration parity is preserved while repository hygiene is restored.

move_tag_contract.invariant: move tags classify structural migration readiness only; they do not imply AIQ/work-package completion, production maturity, source deletion, or independent verification

cutover_tags.cutover:parity-ready: Exact mirror is structurally prepared for import inversion after global gates and focused regression validation.
cutover_tags.cutover:owner-sensitive: One or more provider/credential/network owner surfaces remain compatibility facades and require explicit ownership/import cutover.
cutover_tags.cutover:quarantine: Historical/model-internals/research lineage remains characterization-gated and is not a production cutover candidate.
cutover_tags.cutover:merge-required: Compatibility/convergence mirror overlaps an existing canonical owner and must be merged into that owner before legacy source retirement.

batches.B1-core-runtime: Core runtime, provider-neutral, agent, cognition, learning, evaluation, reliability and state surfaces.
batches.B2-domain-build: Build/repository engineering, simulation and Forge surfaces.
batches.B3-owner-sensitive: Mappings containing compatibility facades or explicit parity exceptions; cut over only after authority-owner review.
batches.B4-research-quarantine: Historical or model-internals research lineage; characterize before any production promotion.
batches.B3-compat-convergence: Compatibility mirrors staged only for convergence into an existing canonical runtime owner; never promoted as independent production authorities.

pre_move_readiness.invariant: Preparation metadata and move tags authorize staging only; source retirement/import inversion requires fresh parity/object evidence, green affected-domain gates, and required signoffs.

validation_request.reason: Force repository-native validation after transfer-v2 was assembled through Git object/ref operations that did not emit a PR Actions run for the resulting head.
validation_request.invariant: This request records validation intent only and does not change cutover or completion authority.
